name: Driving Licence (Sarathi / Parivahan)
department_id: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
ministry_id: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
description: Application for learner's licence, driving licence, and renewals through the Parivahan Sarathi portal.
benefits: Legal authorisation to drive; valid identity/address proof.
application_steps: Visit Sarathi Parivahan and select your state.
Apply for Learner's Licence and pay fees.
After the mandatory period, apply for the driving licence.
Book and pass the driving test at the RTO.
Receive the DL by post / download.
processing_time: Learner's licence same day (online test); DL after driving test, ~7-30 days.
validity: 20 years or until age 40 (whichever earlier), then renewable.
office_locator_info: Regional Transport Office (RTO) locator on Parivahan.
ai_summary: Driving Licence (Sarathi / Parivahan) is a central government service under Ministry of Road Transport and Highways in the Transport category, available both.
ai_explanation: Driving Licence (Sarathi / Parivahan) is Application for learner's licence, driving licence, and renewals through the Parivahan Sarathi portal. Eligibility: Minimum age 16 (gearless <50cc) / 18 (LMV); pass driving test.. Benefits: Legal authorisation to drive; valid identity/address proof.. You can apply both via https://parivahan.gov.in. Processing time is typically Learner's licence same day (online test); DL after driving test, ~7-30 days. and fees are Learner's ~Rs.150; DL ~Rs.200+ (varies by state RTO)..
